title: Street Corn Taco Beef Bowls (Easy Taco Bowl Recipe)
reject_reason: Ground-beef taco meat (taco seasoning, tomato paste, lime) served as a bowl duplicates live loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls on 3 of 4 axes (beef/taco-tomato/bowl); the elote topping and sweet-potato base are toppings/base swaps, not a distinct dinner, in an already-saturated Tex-Mex beef region.
